contract_name: FrostLink Raw Telemetry to ML Feature Engineering Contract

raw_input_specification.probes_format: Key-value mapping of probe identifier (string) to Celsius temperature (float64 or null)

output_specification.enforced_ordering: Strict deterministic index order matching model training schema

temporal_window_rules.lookahead_policy: STRICTLY CAUSAL: No observation at tau > t is ever accessed.

cold_start_policy.description: During the first 50 minutes of a shipment (< 6 telemetry packets), rolling features use expanding causal slices with min_periods=1. Delta slopes use available historical difference. Missing long slopes default to short slopes or NaN. The model handles early-trip NaNs natively through default tree branches.

hardware_mapping.cargo_probes: Multi-point DS18B20 1-Wire Digital Thermometer Mesh or RTD Pt100 Sensors (5 to 9 probe nodes)
hardware_mapping.telemetry_gateway: ESP32 Cellular/NB-IoT Telematics Gateway transmitting ISO-8601 packet frames
hardware_mapping.confidence_score: Computed on gateway based on CRC-8 packet validity and probe checksums

failure_modes.all_probes_null: Feature vector emits NaN for spatial metrics; sconf drops to 0.0.
failure_modes.out_of_order_packets: Packets are automatically sorted by timestamp ascending before extraction.
failure_modes.duplicate_timestamps: Deduplicated by keeping the latest received packet for that timestamp.
